description: Compare two to five stock tickers in one compact structured response: annual fundamentals and growth, quality ratios, stored valuation and Bullrun model context, and measured risk dials. Reports each fiscal year, source date, native quote/reporting currency and missing coverage. No currency conversion, quarterly-to-annual substitution, buy/sell ranking or generated research. Read-only.

include.description: Selected compact modules. Fundamentals and quality use the latest usable ANNUAL fiscal year only; valuation includes stored multiples and Bullrun model context; risk includes measured dials.

tickers.description: Two to five distinct Bullrun stock tickers, e.g. AAPL, BMW, NESN, 6324.T or 7203. Bullrun tickers: US and most European listings use the plain local symbol (AAPL, BMW, NESN, ABBN); most Asian and Indian listings keep their exchange suffix (Tokyo 6324.T, Hong Kong 0700.HK, Shanghai 600519.SS, Shenzhen 000001.SZ, Taiwan 2330.TW, Korea 000100.KS, Singapore D05.SI, India RELIANCE.NS), but some Japanese and Korean large caps are plain codes (Toyota 7203, Samsung 005930). Either form is resolved automatically when exactly one listing matches; use search_stocks to find a ticker by company name or ISIN. Company names are not accepted here.
